document.title: Loneliness among young people
document.question:
In many countries, more and more young people say they feel lonely, even though social media keeps them constantly connected. Some blame technology, while others point to changes in the way people live.

What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done to solve it?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
